title: Ojha's Pile
description: This mod adds many random items to enhance your playthrough.
body:
After over 6 months of work, I present to you, Ojha's Pile. Filled with much more random things than the rest of my mods, and good ones at that, I am sure somehting here will fit in your shoes. Between orange, teal, and some white-ol' wood, to a whole new brass toolset, this mod is right for everyone needing a quick refresh of Minecraft. With a few more plants, such as Ajuga reptans, plantains, and sedges, as well as thigh-highs, two new music discs by me, and sushimis of many types, if you need smehtging in a mod, we have it here. Download Ojha's Pile, today!
